source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.4「フライトコントロールシステム」(2)4)高度センサ

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 高度センサは方式ごとに気圧変化・音波反射時間・レーザー反射時間を利用する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 異なるsensor modalityの測定原理を混同する。
evidence.reasoning_path: altitude need -> sensor modality -> physical measurement principle

collision.note: LOW。既存bankに高度sensorの方式比較は見当たらない。

independent_review.rationale: 4.4 directly distinguishes barometric, ultrasonic and LiDAR altitude-measurement principles; no canonical item tests the sensor-principle mapping.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review is source-consistent, preserves second-class scope, and correctly rejects two sensor-fact candidates whose answer-defining propositions are already represented in released questions. The remaining 28 candidates cover distinct Chapter 4 system characteristics, equipment boundaries, sensor principles, powertrain/battery behavior, and radio propagation with useful commercial practice value.
